note: Counts are computed from the files in this repository. Zero means the corresponding file has no coded rows. It is not a search result and it is not a completed review.

duplicates.note: A record is removed only when a human has marked SAME_RECORD and named retained_record_id. Unconfirmed candidates stay in the set.

title_abstract.note: Calibration files are not included in these counts.

included.note: Publication, study, deployment, and scenario counts are different units. They are not interchangeable.
